objective: Describe how current Film Grunge and Film Damage scratch/dust equations differ in object density, pixel-relative scale, overlay response and resolution behavior when isolated from other effect components.

effects: Film Grunge source equations: scratchAmount .22 and dustAmount .18 defaults; all other controls zeroed; fixed frame 0 / seed 1977.
Film Damage source equations: scratches .10 and dust .08 defaults; all other controls zeroed; fixed evolution 0 / seed 1977.
Resolution comparison at 512x512 and 1024x1024 using the same centered photographic crop and deterministic synthetic line/flat chart.
render_paths: Independent Python/OpenCV morphology models using source-observed count, size, modulation and compositing rules; seeded PCG64 placements are exploratory and do not reproduce std::mt19937 outputs.
excluded: C++ / installed-effect parity and product image acceptance
grain, gate weave, flicker, burn, vignette, stain, threshold or parameter-default changes
physical film reference, aesthetic ranking, user preference
alpha-edge input contract; test plates are opaque

baseline.kind: Each same source plate with scratch and dust controls disabled.
baseline.role: Paired pixel baseline for per-effect residual, clipping and unchanged-source checks; not a film reference.

candidates: Film Grunge scratch-only at its source default scratchAmount .22.
Film Grunge dust-only at its source default dustAmount .18.
Film Damage scratch-only at its source default Scratches .10.
Film Damage dust-only at its source default Dust .08.

ground_truth.rationale: No approved damage plate or physical film scan is available; deterministic fixtures reveal morphology and source-response only.

materials.source: In-script deterministic 1024x1024 opaque RGB chart with flat tones, fine lines, checker patches and a low-contrast gradient.
materials.rights: Synthetic diagnostic generated by the study script.
materials.identity: Generator damage-morphology-resolution-r1; seed and dimensions recorded in metrics.json.

materials.rights: CC0 1.0; source and derivation in experiments/GlowLab/assets/SOURCES.md.

conditions.resolution: Both materials use a centered square crop at 512x512 and 1024x1024. The 512 view is generated from the same 1024 source crop using Pillow LANCZOS; no candidate-specific resizing.
conditions.color_space: Input numeric RGB values are used directly as float32 normalized code values in [0,1], matching the tested equation domain assumption; this does not assert product working-space semantics.
conditions.transfer: No additional transfer conversion. All candidates and baselines use the same input array. Display sheets clip to [0,1], encode standard sRGB and quantize RGB8.
conditions.display_transform: No exposure or tone mapping; common [0,1] clip and sRGB encoding for diagnostic PNG only.
conditions.alpha_handling: Opaque alpha 1.0 for every input and output. Transparent behavior is outside this study.
conditions.frame_or_sequence: One still; Film Grunge frame 0 and Film Damage evolution 0.
conditions.seed: Seed 1977 is used as the common declared label, but PCG64 placements are generated independently per model and resolution; they are not C++ random-sequence matches.
conditions.output_format: JSON with plan/source/script/input hashes, component counts, mask/coverage/length metrics, finite/range measurements and full/detail contact sheets.

effect_correctness.method: Verify source marker hashes and each registered count/geometry rule; zero control must be exact identity; fixed seed/config must reproduce identical model outputs; output alpha and finite values must be preserved.
effect_correctness.judge: Research author using declared formulas and deterministic model checks.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Only model invariants are gates. Report measured morphology descriptively; no effect quality pass, ranking, or matched-strength claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Record scratch pixel count, normalized length, horizontal occupancy, dust connected-component count/area/radius, RGB residual mean/RMS/quantiles, range crossings and 1:1 morphology crops.
image_quality_and_detail.judge: Descriptive source-model measurements plus author visual inspection; not aesthetic acceptance.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: Report model/resolution separately; do not infer equivalent control meaning from numeric values or compare raw strength as equal.
major_defects: resampled values included as model residual

color_and_alpha.method: Record per-channel raw residual ranges, below-zero/above-one values before preview clipping, output alpha identity and display clipping separately.
regions: synthetic midtone and high/low line ROIs
color_and_alpha.judge: Research author from raw float buffers and fixed display transform.
color_and_alpha.acceptance_criteria: No alpha generalization from opaque plates; additive versus overlay compositing semantics must be explicitly named.

temporal_stability.reason: This study uses one frame per condition and exploratory placement RNG.
temporal_stability.resolution_plan: Use a separately preregistered frame-sequence plan to compare adjacent frames, repeated seeks and evolution policy before suite acceptance.

render_paths_and_resolution.reason: Python formula models only; two still resolutions do not establish preview/final or compiled-path parity.
render_paths_and_resolution.resolution_plan: Capture current installed CPU and supported product path at paired resolutions and compare normalized 1:1 ROIs before product claims.

performance.reason: No product runtime, allocations or memory measurement.
performance.resolution_plan: Profile warmed product calls at both resolutions and representative control combinations before completion.

execution.preview_and_final: No product Viewer/final capture; research PNGs only.
execution.performance_budget: Not measured; no product budget conclusion.
execution.measurement_conditions: Validate plan JSON parsing and source hashes before running. Record script/plan/input hashes and Python/NumPy/OpenCV/Pillow versions. Use deterministic PCG64 placements, distinct per model/resolution, with repeated run determinism checks.

threshold_policy.owner: The user owns later visual acceptance and production control semantics.
